title: Special OpenAI email is apparently a direct line to Sam Altman
excerpt: "Literally anybody can complain about big company bullsh*t directly to Sam."
content_html:
OpenAI employees apparently have a quick way to reach founder and CEO Sam Altman, Fortune reported.

It's an email address, [email protected], and its purpose is to give employees a place to report company problems that OpenAI's leadership team can triage and handle.

The friction@ inbox has existed for a while, according to Fortune, but its use widened when Fidji Simo joined OpenAI as CEO of Applications in the fall of 2025. Simo went on a "listening tour" to better understand problems across the company, and formalized the friction@ process. She assigned Irina Kofman, VP of strategic initiatives and operations, to monitor the inbox and ensure that issues were resolved. Simo also established a monthly, company-wide Slack update to track progress, Fortune reported.

You May Also Like

Simo has since left OpenAI, but these processes remain. One former OpenAI employee told Fortune that the system gives leadership an effective way to hear employee feedback.

"It's a good thing — literally anybody can complain about big company bullsh*t directly to Sam, and they can act on it," the former employee told Fortune.

Mashable Light Speed

Examples Fortune reported include a pilot program to prioritize parking spots for workers with longer commutes to combat full lots, and a more reliable process for granting API credits.

However, a problem brought to friction@ only gets resolved if Altman and OpenAI President Greg Brockman consider it "worthy," another former employee, who led a team at the company, told Fortune. Unlike the other former OpenAI employee, this person said the process created inefficiency.

"The individual who reports the issue probably thinks it's the single most important thing, but to teams like mine that are constantly underwater, under-resourced, and over-leveraged, it’s the single most disruptive thing you could do," they told Fortune.

It's certainly a way for Sam Altman to get internal real-time critique. For external critique, he can go to X, like when he suggested parents make AI podcasts about their children.

Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, in April 2025 filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it infringed Ziff Davis copyrights in training and operating its AI systems.

content_html_zh:
据《财富》杂志报道，OpenAI 员工显然可以快速联系到创始人兼首席执行官 Sam Altman。

这是一个电子邮件地址，[email protected]，其目的是为员工提供一个报告公司问题的地方，OpenAI 的领导团队可以对这些问题进行分类和处理。

据《财富》报道，摩擦@收件箱已经存在了一段时间，但当 Fidji Simo 于 2025 年秋季加入 OpenAI 担任应用程序首席执行官后，它的使用范围扩大了。 Simo 进行了一次“倾听之旅”，以更好地了解整个公司的问题，并将摩擦@流程正式化。 她指派战略计划和运营副总裁伊琳娜·科夫曼 (Irina Kofman) 监控收件箱并确保问题得到解决。 据《财富》杂志报道，Simo 还建立了全公司范围内的每月 Slack 更新来跟踪进度。

你可能也喜欢

Simo 此后离开了 OpenAI，但这些流程仍然存在。 一位前 OpenAI 员工告诉《财富》杂志，该系统为领导层提供了一种听取员工反馈的有效方式。

“这是一件好事——实际上任何人都可以直接向萨姆抱怨大公司的废话，他们可以采取行动，”这位前雇员告诉《财富》杂志。

可混搭光速

《财富》报道的例子包括一项试点计划，该计划优先考虑为通勤时间较长的工人提供停车位，以应对停车位满的情况，以及授予 API 积分的更可靠的流程。

然而，领导该公司团队的另一位前员工告诉《财富》杂志，只有 Altman 和 OpenAI 总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 认为“值得”，摩擦@带来的问题才能得到解决。 与另一名前 OpenAI 员工不同，此人表示该流程效率低下。

他们告诉《财富》杂志：“报告这个问题的人可能认为这是最重要的事情，但对于像我这样经常陷入水下、资源不足和过度杠杆化的团队来说，这是你能做的最具破坏性的事情。”

这无疑是萨姆·奥尔特曼获得内部实时批评的一种方式。 对于外部批评，他可以去 X，就像他建议父母制作关于孩子的人工智能播客一样。

披露：Mashable 的母公司 Ziff Davis 于 2025 年 4 月对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其在训练和运营其人工智能系统时侵犯了 Ziff Davis 的版​​权。
